screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Let's look at the spend jar.

screens.title: Spending on purpose

cards.caption: You decided this before you went to the shop.
Grabbing extra things empties the jar fast.

screens.penny: The spend jar has a bottom, {name}. That's the point.

screens.story: Sofia's spend jar has 3 coins. She sees a pen for 3 coins. She sees a sticker for 2.
screens.prompt: She wants both. What can she do?

options.label: Pick one this time
options.outcome: Sofia picks the pen. The sticker is still there next week. Her jar fills up again.

options.label: Take both and worry later
options.outcome: Sofia does not have enough for both. She puts one back at the till.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Picking one keeps her plan working.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Her jar holds 3 coins. She can choose one thing today.

screens.prompt: Sofia had 3 coins and the pen cost 3. Put what is left in her jar.
screens.rightMessage: Her jar is nearly empty, {name}, and that's fine. It fills up again.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! She spent almost all of it. Let's move just 1 coin.

screens.prompt: Sofia's spend jar is empty until next week. Is that a problem?
screens.pennyHint: Her other jars are still full, {name}.

choices.label: Yes, she has no money at all

screens.rightMessage: That's right, {name}! Her save and give jars are untouched.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! An empty spend jar just means she used her plan.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about her jars again, {name}.

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: The spend jar is for choosing on purpose.
